name: Himuro Aya
source:
A second-year student at Seishin Academy and a member of the track and field club. She is a competitive young lady who sees [url=/c121751]Fujima Nagisa[/url] as her one-sided rival. Nagisa is not particularly competitive, so it's a bit bothersome.

[From [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/saiminseishidou/character_page08.html]official site[/url]]
